prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The depth map shows a high-ceilinged retail interior with overhead rectangular light fixtures above, a back window wall roughly 4 to 5 metres away, and an angled slatted right wall with a mirror about 1.5 to 2.5 metres to the right in frames 1 to 3. In frames 1 to 3, a woman stands in front of the window wall at the lower left-centre about 2.5 to 3 metres from the camera wearer (outside arm's reach), with her lower body cropped below the frame and a grey garment on her shoulder slightly brighter and closer than her head. Across frames 4 and 5, as the camera wearer turns left and approaches, this woman shifts to the right side of the frame and brightens to within 0.8 to 1.2 metres (entering arm's reach), while a second person wearing glasses appears at the lower left of frame 5 about 1.5 to 2 metres away, separated from the first woman by roughly 1.2 to 1.5 metres with metal clothing racks between them at 1 to 1.8 metres depth. Compared to RGB alone, the depth map clearly separates the foreground silhouette of the approaching woman and the intermediate metal clothing racks in frame 5 from the background window wall despite heavy motion blur in frame 4 and dark clothing. However, the map is unreliable on the bright ceiling light in frame 3 (which appears spuriously close), across the reflective mirror in frames 1 and 2, and across frames 1 to 5 where per-frame normalisation causes the upper wall and ceiling to fluctuate wildly between bright and dark.
descriptions.segmentation: The instance segmentation map isolates the people in the lower portion of the scene against the high-ceilinged room with windows and clothing racks seen in the RGB strip. It tracks the main woman in pink masks from the lower left-centre at roughly 2.5 to 3 metres distance in frames 1 and 2, down to just the crown of her head at the bottom edge in frame 3, and moving closer (about 1.5 metres in frame 4 to under 1 metre in frame 5) on the right side as the camera wearer turns left and approaches her. It also detects a partial brown 'person' mask at the far right edge of frame 1 (a reflection or partial head about 1.5 metres away in the mirror) and a brown 'person' mask for the second person at the lower left of frame 5 roughly 1.5 to 2 metres away and about 1.2 to 1.5 metres left of the first woman, with all individuals cropped below the shoulders or head by the bottom frame boundary. Compared to the RGB image, the segmentation map cleanly delineates the main woman's silhouette during severe motion blur in frame 4 and merges the grey garment on her shoulder into her contour in frames 1 and 2, showing she is outside arm's reach until frame 5. The map is unreliable in frame 1 where the entire room background is mislabelled as a green 'train' mask, and across all frames where it completely misses the hanging clothes, mirror, ceiling lights, and the metal clothing racks within arm's reach between the two people in frame 5.
descriptions.pose: The pose map plots 2D facial and upper-body keypoints in yellow against a black background, capturing head and shoulder orientations as the camera pitched upward crops everyone below the chest or neck. In frames 1 and 2, clustered facial keypoints and a shoulder line in frame 1 at the lower left-centre (~2.5 to 3 metres away) show the main woman facing forward and slightly left while looking toward the camera wearer. After disappearing in frame 3 when her face drops below the bottom frame edge, her skeleton reappears at the lower centre-right in frame 4 (~1.5 metres away) and far right in frame 5 (~0.8 to 1.2 metres away, within arm's reach), with facial keypoints and a right-to-left shoulder vector in frame 5 showing her head and torso turned in left profile looking toward the second person on the left rather than the camera wearer. Compared to RGB alone, the skeleton map makes her head orientation and torso box explicit through the heavy motion blur of frame 4, although no magenta hand keypoints appear in any frame because all hands and arms are occluded or out of view below the lower frame border. The pose map is unreliable where it hallucinated a compact torso rectangle on the blurred head/neck region in frame 4 and completely fails to detect the second person wearing glasses at the lower left of frame 5 (~1.5 to 2 metres away, facing and looking toward the right) as well as the partial head in frames 1 and 3.
